{{Quote|Seventh Octant, right at the edge of our view.|Imperial sensor office|<ref name="COO" />}}
The '''Seventh Octant''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]].<ref name="COO" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]] offered the [[Mine/Legends|mines]] within the Seventh Octant to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. According to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the octant's tunnel system was about as convoluted as a [[noodle-bake]].<ref name="COO" />
